svg.text: FOR THE OWNER
Notes
STATUS RULES (VS TARGET, INDEPENDENT OF THE COMPARATOR)
Net sales
Watch when −3% to 0% vs budget; Off track below −3%.
Total margin
Watch when −1.0 pp to 0 vs budget; Off track below −1.0 pp. Provisional until the
monthly true-up.
Weeks of cover
On track within ±1 wk of target 9.5; Watch 1–2 wks away; Off track beyond ±2 wks.
Markdown
Lower is better. Watch when 0 to +1.0 pp vs budget; Off track above +1.0 pp.
Availability
On track at 97% or above; Watch 95–97%; Off track below 95%.
EBITDA flash
Watch when −5% to 0 vs budget; Off track below −5%. Provisional until month-end
close.
Like-for-like growth
Watch when −2 pp to 0 vs budget LFL; Off track below −2 pp.
Front gross margin
Watch when −1.0 pp to 0 vs budget; Off track below −1.0 pp.
Sell-through
Watch when −5 pp to 0 vs the season target; Off track below −5 pp.
GMROI
On track at 2.5× or above; Watch 2.0–2.5×; Off track below 2.0×.
Supplier OTIF
On track at 95% or above; Watch 92–95%; Off track below 92%.
Channel mix
On track within ±2 pp of the plan mix per channel; Watch 2–3 pp away; Off track beyond
3 pp.
WHERE THE MARGINS MEET
Front margin = Net sales − COGS at landed cost. Back margin = contract rate × qualifying purchases, accrued weekly,
provisional until the monthly true-up. Total margin = front + back. Markdown already reduces the sell price, so it is
shown as % of gross sales and never enters the margin sum twice. EBITDA = Total margin − shrink − store OpEx −
central OpEx − fulfilment.
DATA CONTRACT
Facts at week × site × category: sales, budget, week-end stock, forecast cost of goods, availability, receipts; supplier
income and PO lines at week × supplier; OpEx at week × cost type × site × scenario.
LY by week key on the 4-5-4 retail calendar (week 43 ↔ LY week 43, never the same dates). LFL flag per retail
period (open ≥ 13 months, not closed, not refitted). Provisional flag on back margin and EBITDA flash until close.
This report imports the week-grain tables from Parquet (week × site × category); stores, suppliers and SKUs stay
below the cards.
